notes.title: ARTIUS: Pure Imagination to Join 2025 Multiplayer Games Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Artists！[/p][p][/p][p][b]ARTIUS: Pure Imagination[/b] is crashing the [b]Multiplayer Games Fest[/b] from [b]August 4 to August 12[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]During the event, we will be live streaming ARTIUS’s [b]multiplayer mode[/b] on Steam. Tune in and enjoy the show![/p][p][/p][p]A lot of updates are on the way, so add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned to be the first to know what's coming up![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3599920/_ARTIUS/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546324/6151fa4c1ad89cd03b8fac0c1a55a6359555a6ea.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: PVic Games x IndieArk Join Forces!
notes.notes: [p]Dear Artists,[/p][p][/p][p]We are overjoyed to share that [b]PVic Games[/b] has entered into an official partnership with [b]IndieArk,[/b] a distinguished publisher from China![/p][p][/p][p]Since unveiling our game’s store page, we’ve been deeply touched by the overwhelming support from players around the globe. As we dedicate ourselves to crafting [i]ARTIUS: Pure Imagination[/i] with passion, IndieArk will lend their expertise in multilingual localization, marketing, and beyond.[/p][p][/p][p]This collaboration allows us to focus on refining every detail of the game to deliver an exceptional experience![/p][p][/p][p]Please join our Discord channel if you are interested in the game. Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! <3[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45546324/f4847224e0b939722e7b8d8f173c9f8ada4c2893.gif"][/img][/p][p]From PVic Games[/p]
